scope: Adds a research-only, stability-first randomized-subspace selector for the routed long B/E/T base heads. It uses target-free candidate features, strict pre-reserve labels for fitting, timestamp-local enhanced-base economics for selection, and writes only immutable research artifacts. Live inference, exchange I/O, consensus, MC1, admission, portfolio, and execution contracts are excluded.

commands: Cross-year smoke sequence on E: November 2025, March 2026, June 2026. All three strict OOF folds completed; the intentionally undersized four-model smoke stopped only because inclusion evidence requires at least 12 randomized subspaces.

Full 48-subspace E selection strict_r3_base_stability_selector_e_20260826_v1 completed: 1,407 causal fields -> 1,010 hygiene-valid -> 891 after rho>=0.97 pruning -> 420 empirical survivors; target_fields_in_feature_matrix=false and coverage spans 2025-07 through 2026-06.

Five-fold/two-seed incumbent-versus-large-contract reference validation completed as strict_r3_stability_reference_e_20260826_v1. Its default folds are 2025-11, 2026-01, 2026-03, 2026-05, and 2026-07; selector/reference scripts now reject a non-cross-year or insufficiently spread fold set.

Strict cross-year enhanced-B0 counterpart ledger completed as strict_r3_b0_crossyear_oof_20260826_v1: 179,861 held rows, zero duplicate identities, zero missing scores, and 100% coverage of the five-fold E reference population.

The selector and reference evaluator accept only a strict-OOF enhanced-B0 score ledger as a counterpart override. Compact E contracts of 200/120/70 stable-inclusion-ranked fields are running over the same cross-year five-fold reference; the malformed v2 startup artifacts contain no fit results and are not evidence.
validation.not_run_reason: The selection result, compression, HPO, blend grid, and downstream validation remain in progress. No live or exchange test applies because this change is research-only.
